name: department-of-prose
description: Detect, score, explain, and rewrite AI writing patterns in Claude Code and Codex. Three skills: slop-sense (detect + rewrite + ai;dr), slop-check (score only, no rewrite), slop-explain (per-pattern deep-dives). 36 AI writing patterns, algorithmic SLOP scorer (0-100), plus a rhythm checker for burstiness and structural tells.
